text: Ka hulɓinngol fii jeeno Alla jaŋtii wonnde on gaadariiɗo ɗum o rerɗantaa fii resugol si wanaa debbo jinoowo wano makko maaɗum sirkoowo mo rentotaako e jina wonndude e waasude dagagol resugol mo, on debbo wowtiniiɗo jeeno o rerɗan- taa reseede si wanaa gorko jinoowo wano makko maaɗum sirkoowo mo rentotaako hurum jom galle makko, na harminaa e dow gomɗinɓe ɓen resugol debbo jinoowo on e resinngol gorko jInoowo on.
